question: top 3 customers by spend
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.amount) as total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3;

question: how many products are in the Electronics category
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category='Electronics';

question: which city has the highest revenue
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(p.amount) as revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: how many orders were cancelled
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled';
